title: Signal library
description: library.json at the root of a signal library (everything-ecosystem docs/design/SIGNAL_LIBRARY_2026-11-06.md): a source that holds signal types and signals in the naive-signal-library@1 layout and is read in place. The layout: library.json; types/<id>/<version>.signal.json (the components); signals/<type>/<subject>/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<id>.json (the elements, immutable); log/<type>/<yyyy-mm-dd>.jsonl (the append-only day index). library.json lists no types: they are whatever types/ holds. A venture lists a library as a source with carries signals in knowledge/sources.json. Naive's own packages are the implicit library naive (open types only), and a venture's raw/signals/ is its implicit local library (signals and log only); neither has a library.json. Nothing reads a library yet: the connector and the pull are later build items.

id.description: The library's id; naive and local are reserved for the implicit libraries

contract.description: The layout contract the library keeps

license.description: An SPDX license id, or proprietary with the terms named in note
